question: A repository holds an incomplete object that is reachable only from an unrelated, unselected branch. Would refusing the whole --all object graph add scope or harm?
answer: Both. The audit's evidence roots are the pinned selected lane branch tip and the pinned fleet HEAD; every object outside those roots is unread evidence. Refusing the --all graph would (a) import objects the audit never reads into the required set (scope creep), (b) turn a repository that is complete for every required piece of evidence into could-not-evaluate (the same over-refusal harm class that got r23 rejected), and (c) make the verdict depend on unrelated local refs the operator happens to have.

evidence_roots.how: resolve_branch(): refs/heads/<branch> peeled to a commit, pinned once
evidence_roots.covers: git log <tip> (all ancestors, round candidates), corpus/SOURCES.md blob at tip, registry/report-landing-errata.tsv blob at tip
report blob at HEAD (git show HEAD:<rel>), report path history / first-add cutoff (git log --diff-filter=A -- <rel>)

evidence_roots.how: cat-file --batch-check per repo over the local object store
evidence_roots.covers: cited hashes, Landed tokens, errata corrections

not_evidence: refs other than refs/heads/<branch> (other branches, remote-tracking refs, tags, stash)
objects unreachable from the roots (dangling, unrelated branch tips)
objects of paths the audit does not read

rows.name: N01-missing-object-unselected-branch
rows.fixture: lane marked promisor; missing blob of the unselected `side` branch; fleet ordinary

rows.name: N02-missing-object-fleet-unselected-branch
rows.fixture: lane and fleet marked promisor; missing blob of the fleet's unselected `side` branch

rows.name: N03-missing-object-selected-branch
rows.fixture: marked lane; the missing blob IS reachable from the selected lane branch
rows.note: discriminating control: a root-scoped closure check must report this one; never a clean or failed verdict

rows.name: N04-unmarked-twin-control
rows.fixture: identical content, partial-clone metadata removed, same missing object present
rows.note: fixes the substantive verdict independently of any candidate; the marked fixture must reproduce it byte for byte

mutants_that_must_be_killed.effect_on_N01: exit 2 (missing object of an unselected branch)
